placements.title: Architecture decisions shaping the system
placements.frame: What architecture decisions are being made, and what do they commit the system to?

placements.title: From PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for analytics
placements.frame: What drives the analytics database platform migration, and what consequences follow from it?
placements.why: All three expressions cohere around the decision to migrate the analytics database from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB, justified by 10x query performance and lower licensing cost, with a Q3 2026 timeline. This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — migration progress, realized gains, and follow-on decisions — not a one-time fact. src-1 performs the switch as settled, src-2 supplies the quantified justification, and src-3 records the decision formally with its timeline.
